description:
White diamonds, emeralds, and rubies. Discover timeless nature combined with Italian craftsmanship. Gival Gioielli carefully selects all the precious stones to create high jewelry creations. Gival Gioielli's masterpieces are born from ambitious designers' inspiration and come alive with the in-house artisans' helping hands. The artistry is done entirely by hand using ancient jewelry-making techniques that date back to the 1st century BC. Gival Gioielli creates unique, elegant, refined high jewelry. Gival Gioielli carefully selects various precious stones such as rubies, emeralds, morganite, aquamarine, sapphire, tanzanite, and diamonds to create timeless limited pieces.
-
We are currently looking for affiliates and brand ambassadors for our exclusive Gival Gioielli 18kt Masterpieces. All items are Made in Italy. This exclusive collection ranges from 300$ to 50,000$. We are offering Free Shipping from Italy to North America, all Gival items are insured with hassle-free returns. We also assign a responsive affiliate manager. Daily data feed available, professional, and consistently updated creative banners, images, and product videos. 
-
Here are just some of the perks when you become a Found in Italy affiliate?
Generous Commission Rates with the ability to get higher commissions based on performance. Access to exclusive events and VIP all-inclusive travel destinations in Italy. 

Welcome to the club.
